implementation.producer: Actual install engine phase/archive/selected target/partition/package inventory and EXIT-handler hooks
implementation.privacy: Explicit kind/field/value projection; no raw performance rows, command output, answers, URLs or configuration
implementation.terminal_boundary: Actual installer EXIT status after final pool export; earlier performance-trace exit is excluded
implementation.package_identity: Actual name/version registry snapshot once at finish or failure; download/extraction performance rows are not replayed into the bounded medium log
implementation.input_creation: Atomic replacement of a fresh private file; no leaf-symlink following
implementation.background_relay: Inode-pinned incremental kqueue reader; 8192-byte source rows, 32768-byte batches, 5-second flush interval
implementation.native_commit: Existing serialized boot-trace wrapper and admission/frame writer; contiguous per-attempt sequences and last-batch retry idempotency
implementation.failure_policy: Refuse invalid/overflowing input, retain preceding committed evidence, record unavailable privately and preserve the original installer status
implementation.rc_interpreter: Use the staged absolute Python path; ordinary FreeBSD rc PATH lacks usr/local/bin
